Title: Register and login via API automation
Steps: 1. Register unique user. 2. Login with same credentials. 3. Capture token.
Expected Result: HTTP 200; token returned and usable for protected calls.

Title: Create valid order with auth token
Steps: 1. Use token from login. 2. Submit valid order payload. 3. Assert HTTP 200.

Title: Reject order when stock unavailable
Steps: 1. Submit oversized quantity. 2. Call order endpoint.
Expected Result: HTTP 409; response contains insufficient stock error.

Title: Require authentication for order creation
Steps: 1. Attempt order creation without auth header. 2. Review response.

Title: Read catalog through API client
Expected Result: HTTP 200; product list returns consistent Schema.

Title: Read admin logs with valid auth
Steps: 1. Authenticate. 2. Request logs endpoint. 3. Inspect data.
Expected Result: HTTP 200 and audit log records returned.

Title: Policy endpoint returns business policy text
Validate order persists to database after API call
Steps: 1. Query latest order row for user. 2. Join order_items. 3. Match total and quantity.
Expected Result: Order persists in DB exactly as created.

Title: Validate product stock decrements after order
Steps: 1. Capture stock before order. 2. Order product. 3. Re-query stock.
Expected Result: Stock decreases by the expected quantity only.

Title: Validate audit log entry after successful order
Steps: 1. Query the latest record in audit_logs. 2. Match level and message.
Expected Result: A success log is stored for order creation.
